planrun1_initial.promise: RecallDesk automates rebooking outreach, turning no-shows and cancellations into rescheduled visits with minimal staff effort.
proof_points: Detects no-shows and cancellations automatically within the practice management system.
Sends a rebooking invitation via SMS or WhatsApp to the patient.
Patients can reply with a preferred time, book via a link, or request a callback.
